_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest for issue #1822 / #1872 paired proof. Read by apps/front/scripts/ci/run-preuves.mts BEFORE classification. Each test declared in `expectedRed` MUST fail with an AssertionError on correct code. If a declared kept-red test PASSES, the runner fails CI with verdict CORRUPT PROOF. The `measuredAgainst` SHA points at the commit that introduced the proof itself, so the runner has an audit trail for the proof's provenance. Filled in after the proof is committed in this lane.

expectedRed.testName: server.mjs still imports the pre-#1628 `serveStatic` from srvx/static (#1822/#1872)
expectedRed.why: On correct code server.mjs imports `staticMiddleware` (not `serveStatic`), so the regex does not match and `expect(importsServeStatic).toBe(true)` fails with an AssertionError — the kept-red state. If this test PASSES, server.mjs has been reverted to the pre-#1628 import shape (or aliased to it), which makes the front crash at startup under srvx 0.12.7 and re-opens the publish-now e2e regression.

expectedRed.testName: apps/front/server.mjs calls `serveStatic` from srvx/static (#1822/#1872 — call-site contract)
expectedRed.why: On correct code server.mjs carries no `serveStatic` call site at all (`createStaticMiddleware(...)` is what calls the live export), so the word-boundary regex does not match and `expect(callsServeStatic).toBe(true)` fails with an AssertionError — the kept-red state. If this test PASSES, a `serveStatic({...})` call has re-entered server.mjs (with or without the import line), which is the runtime half of the bug and re-opens the publish-now e2e regression at server startup.
